title: Comment on “Re-evaluating fistula management in cleft palate: longitudinal changes and risk determinants after double-opposing Z-plasty”
html: I read the recent article by Jeon et al.1 with interest. This article reports a retrospective study on the determinants of palatal fistula (PF) formation after double-opposing Z-plasty (DOZ). While the cited incidence of PF formation after DOZ was relatively low at 6.7%1, it is important to highlight the risk factors for this event.
